title.narrative: Sector plan for the phase-out of methyl bromide production in China

description.narrative: Sector plan for the phase out of methyl bromide production in China In compliance with the Montreal Protocol, China has to fulfill its obligation to phase out the production and consumption of controlled methyl bromide used for tobacco seedling production, soil fumigation in different crops and commodity fumigation. Moreover, China has to reduce its controlled methyl bromide consumption, by 20% of the base line, by January 1st, 2005 and by 100% by January 1st, 2015 (except for QPS and critical uses).
